item.endpoint: Mean weight loss from baseline at Week 33 (Exploratory control arm continuing weekly dosing)
item.result: VK2735 17.5 mg weekly: 21.7% weight loss; Placebo: 0.3% weight gain
item.analysis: p<0.0001 vs. baseline for VK2735; p<0.0001 vs. placebo
quotes: An exploratory control arm in the study evaluated weight change in a cohort of participants who continued receiving weekly VK2735 doses of 17.5 mg (n=13).
This cohort demonstrated mean weight loss of 21.7% from baseline (Week 0) (p<0.0001 vs. baseline), compared with 0.3% weight gain for placebo (p<0.0001 vs. placebo).
